messages:
alex: Support report: sample app crashed on fncall JSON mode. Suspect SDK helper coercion of null -> [] for nullable arrays.

mira: can you share minimal output + schema?

alex: model returned `{"tags": null}`. Schema: `tags: type ["array","null"] items: type: string`.

tony: parity issue: js helper coerces null->[], py keeps null, go maps to nil -> panic in templates.

alex: worse: retry/auth wrapper re-runs parser and JS helper sometimes coerces twice -> `[[]]`. Seen in two customer incidents.

mira: propose: make normalization idempotent, move normalization into single parse step, add coerceNullables flag for compat.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created ticket DE-5207.

tony: i'll PR tests across js/py/go and update samplekit lint to warn on array|null mismatches.

alex: update onboarding docs + sampleapp templates to prefer explicit defaults and add migration note.

mira: thanks, please link PR here when ready.
